description: Implementation of the TransactionService interface, providing methods for creating transactions, listing transactions for an order, and retrieving capturable or refundable transactions within a payment processing context.

classes.name: TransactionServiceImpl
classes.description: A Spring service implementation for handling transactions, extending a generic service class and implementing transaction-specific logic.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction, serializing its details to JSON before saving.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves and populates transaction details for a given order.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Finds an authorize transaction that can be captured for a specific order.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Finds a transaction that is eligible for refund for a specific order.
